waiting.title: Spec 026: move the tag index out of the manifest and into its own table, with a migration that survives a half-written state
waiting.gist: The largest change in the series. The manifest stops holding tags, a table of its own holds them, and the migration writes a marker row first, so a run stopped halfway can tell which half it finished and resume from there.

waiting.title: sha256 short ids collide at about 40k rows and nothing handles it

waiting.title: The changelog entry for every spec merged since the last release, grouped by area and written for a reader who has not seen the specs
waiting.gist: A paragraph that wraps well past three lines on a phone, to show where the gist stops. It keeps going: the second sentence adds a fact, the third repeats it, and the fourth is here so the paragraph is long enough to show how the row holds a gist this size.
